question: The income of Raman is ₹61,500. He saves 17% of his income. If his income increases by 38% and expenditure increases by 20%, then his savings will:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial saving = 17% of 61500 = 10455

Expenditure = 83% of 61500 = 51045

New income = 61500 × 1.38 = 84870

New expenditure = 51045 × 1.20 = 61254

New saving = 84870 − 61254 = 23616

Increase = 23616 − 10455 = 13161

**∴ Answer = ₹13161**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income = 61500, Saving = 17%

Income increases by 38%, Expenditure increases by 20%

**Formula used:**

Saving = Income − Expenditure

**Calculation:**

⇒ Initial saving = 0.17 × 61500 = 10455

⇒ Initial expenditure = 61500 − 10455 = 51045

⇒ New income = 61500 × 1.38 = 84870

⇒ New expenditure = 51045 × 1.20 = 61254

⇒ New saving = 84870 − 61254 = 23616

⇒ Increase in saving = 23616 − 10455 = 13161

**∴ The correct answer is ₹13161.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Saving Concept

Saving = Income − Expenditure

Percentage Application

Convert percentages into multipliers for quick calculation

Independent Change

Income and expenditure increase separately

Insight

Savings increase depends on difference between new income and new expenditure

e9
